description: This source file defines a utility support module for voice wake recognition debugging and logging, including transcript handling, matching, and summarization functions.

classes.name: TranscriptSummary
classes.description: A structure holding a summary of the transcript, including whether it's text-only and a timing count.

methods.name: shouldLogTranscript
methods.description: Determines whether the transcript should be logged based on level, repetition, and timing constraints.

methods.name: textOnlyFallbackMatch
methods.description: Attempts to generate a wake word match purely based on text content if conditions are met.

methods.name: transcriptSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary indicating if the transcript is text-only and the count of relevant segments.

methods.name: matchSummary
methods.description: Creates a human-readable string summary of a wake word match.
